ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominately low-intensity pixels (>95% dark grey/black) across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity pixels isolated only at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) mass across the entire visible surface. High-contrast contiguous pixel clusters (white/cream) are mapped exclusively to the distal tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35-45 degrees, extending deep into the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe exhibits low-frequency, high-amplitude irregularities, including two distinct deep concave voids/notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the water surface to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular missing segments (notches) along the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips.
